names_note: Lake names are from OpenStreetMap, matched to the catalogue by the team's earlier work (GLOFcast name audit, accepted matches only, data/lake_names_osm.csv), written as in OpenStreetMap. A name matched to an agency report (data/agency_reports_2026.csv) replaces it. Lakes without a name have none in either source. A matched OpenStreetMap name more than 60 m from the outline (often a group or neighbour name) is given as near_name and shown as "near ...".

indicators.title: Water
indicators.question: How full is the lake, and did it change?
indicators.checked: verified by two implementations; the 17 optical events checked by two team members by eye

indicators.title: History
indicators.question: Did the lake empty in earlier summers?
indicators.checked: verified by two implementations; earlier years not checked by eye

indicators.title: Ground at the dam
indicators.question: Does the ground that holds the lake move?
indicators.checked: verified by two implementations; line of sight, one summer, provisional product

indicators.title: Ice beside the lake
indicators.question: Does the glacier next to the lake move measurably?
indicators.source: NISAR GOFF (L-band pixel offsets, 80 m), RGI 7.0 glacier outlines
indicators.checked: verified by two implementations (H8); provisional product; case sheets seen by the assistant, not by a person

indicators.title: Snow and lake ice
indicators.question: When did the basin melt out and freeze again?
indicators.source: Sentinel-2 snow and water shares; NISAR and Sentinel-1 measured against them
indicators.checked: dates from Sentinel-2 on clear days (NDSI at 20 m); verified by two implementations; the radars did not date the autumn change better than chance
indicators.figure_title: Every clear look at 659 lakes, June to October 2026: open water in ochre, ice and snow in blue

indicators.title: People below
indicators.question: How many people live along the river below the lake?
indicators.source: GHS-POP R2023A epoch 2025 (JRC), MERIT Hydro v1.0.1, GeoNames; method after Taylor et al. 2023
indicators.checked: exposure, not risk; flow path and count verified by two implementations; population grid is a model

indicators.title: Agency reports
indicators.question: Did the authorities report work on this lake in 2026?
indicators.checked: pages opened by the main session where stated
